scenarios.name: Switch the selected drawing browser entry

scenario_steps.name: a drawing with a border and title block is open in the MCAD Software
the sheet branch is expanded in the drawing browser
the user selects the sheet border entry in the drawing browser
the border entry is highlighted in the browser
the user selects the sheet title block entry in the drawing browser
the title block entry is highlighted in the browser
the border entry is no longer highlighted as the active selection
